newsitem.title: BRAZIL: MOTOR RACING- VILLENEUVE WINS BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING- VILLENEUVE WINS BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX.

text.p: Jacques Villeneuve of Canada, driving a Williams, won the Brazilian Grand Prix at the Interlagos circuit on Sunday.
Austrian Gerhard Berger, in a Benetton, came second and Olivier Panis of France, driving a Prost was third.
Mika Hakkinen of Finland, in a McLaren came home fourth, Michael Schumacher of Germany in a Ferrari, was fifth and Jean Alessi of France, in a Benetton, finished sixth.
